title: Sugar Bun
transcription:
Sugar Bun

Oh, I wish I were a little sugar bun,
Oh, I wish I were a little sugar bun
Oh, I'd slippy and I'd slidey
down everyone's insidey,
Oh, I wish I were a little sugar bun.

...Fishey in the Sea,
Oh, I'd swimmy in the nudey, without
my bathing suitey.

...Slippery Root,
Oh, I'd grab you by the feetie, and I'd
drop you on your seatie.

...Bar of Soap,
Oh, I'd slippy and I'd slidey over every-
body's body.

...Mosquito,
Oh, I'd stingie and I'd bitie under
everybody's nightie.

...English Sparrow,
Oh, I'd sit up on the steeple, and
deposit on the people.
